properties.name: Which node a merge keeps is a person's pick: propose_heal ranks and recommends, apply_heal keeps the pick
properties.rationale:
THE CAUSE, from the root-cause pass (fact:root-cause-a-merge-deletes-the-wrong-node-because-the-survivor-rule-is-blind-to-status-priority-and-connections-2026-10-14): the accepted rule picked the survivor by provenance and then by node id, and heal.rs did exactly that; nothing read status, priority or connections, and apply_heal refused the swapped operation a person would have used to correct a bad pick. So the class was a destructive merge where the engine both proposed and decided. The fix removes the deciding, not just the tiebreak, on Anthony's word of 2026-10-13 ("Go with your recommendations"; item 23 recorded as "merge survivor: the engine proposes and a person picks, after a root-cause pass").

MEASURED with this build (release, branch head 21db7f39c) on a scratch import of main's design copy, through --call, the two recorded cases reproduced as the root-cause pass did and the 10 suspected same-type pairs asserted so propose_heal would consider them, the one asserted pair's acknowledgement withdrawn; the same store under the published 0.84.0 binary for the before. 13 merges. Before, the id decided every one. After: who:ajs kept over ctr:anthony (connections 1368 against 9; was ctr:anthony); req:graph_is_the_content_bible kept over req:backend_as_product (priority critical against medium, with status and connections named as pointing the other way; was backend_as_product); 2 more pairs now keep the better-connected node (capture-session 4 against 3, how-reflow2-triggers 6 against 3); 6 keep the same node as before but for a real reason (3 by standing, superseded against accepted; 1 by status; 2 by connections); and the 3 TemporalFact pairs that differ in nothing are now "a person must pick" (3 against 3, 4 against 4, 3 against 3 connections; which is newer shown, not weighed).

THE CONTRADICTIONS. heal:0fc0362a90ff913b and heal:7456a4d260ca45ce fired on CONTRADICTS edges from fact:apply-heal-would-have-destroyed-the-wrong-contributor and fact:defect-merge-survivor-ignores-priority-and-status to dec:merge-survivor-provenance. The degree decision's own text anticipated the closure: once the rule changes, the facts become historical observations about the old rule and the edges should be retired as part of that change, not silenced. They were retired by retiring the rule they contradict, not by deleting them: dec:merge-survivor-provenance is superseded (Anthony's approved plan said to supersede it), so the contradiction rule reads each edge as the healthy "refuted, here is what replaced it" shape and the edges stay as the record of why the rule fell. delete_edge was not used because its own description says a link that was true is history to keep. replaces alone (OBSOLETES, discontinued) did not clear them: rehearsed on a scratch import, the sweep stayed 107; with the status moved it went 107 to 105, those two gone and nothing new. The degree decision was left at proposed (retired by OBSOLETES only): superseding it too raised a new unresolved_setup on the old rule's ANTICIPATES edge.

TESTS FIRST: the new core and MCP tests were committed alone (73eb3a9d0) and failed on main 1f46299a0, 10 of 11 and 2 of 2; the one that passed is the round-trip guard. Existing tests changed only where they pinned the defect (the id tiebreak and the ALPHABET line), or where a tie fixture had relied on the alphabet. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: propose_heal now ranks a merge's two candidates instead of deciding. Each merge operation carries a `survivor` block beside its existing fields: both `candidates`, each with `reasons` (provenance, standing, priority, status, connections, and which is newer), a `recommendation`, the signal it was `decided_by`, a `reason`, and `needs_choice`. keep_id is the recommendation, given only when a real difference separates the pair (ladder: provenance, live over withdrawn, priority, settled over open status, connections; newer is shown and never weighed; the id is never a signal). A pair nothing separates stays in the proposal marked needs_choice, its reason beginning "no recommendation: a person must pick". apply_heal accepts either orientation of an offered pair, so a swapped keep/remove is the person's pick, and takes a new optional `chosen_survivor` naming the node to keep; it refuses a needs_choice merge before any write until chosen_survivor is set, re-derived from the design. would_destroy no longer says "THE ALPHABET CHOSE THE VICTIM". Everything apply_heal refused before is still refused, and no tool, argument, reply field or accepted call was removed. In the design: dec:the-engine-proposes-a-merge-and-a-person-picks-the-survivor (accepted, Anthony 2026-10-13) replaces dec:merge-survivor-provenance and dec:a-tied-merge-breaks-by-degree-not-by-alphabet; the first is superseded, which retires the two contradiction defects heal:0fc0362a90ff913b and heal:7456a4d260ca45ce without deleting their CONTRADICTS edges.
